Headline: Chhimek Laghubitta Sanstha Limited to Auction 17,500 Promoter Shares to General Public from Today
Full Content:
The existing promoter shareholders of
Chhimek Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited (CBBL)
are selling 17,500 units of promoter shares to the general public/institutions from today.
Mahendra Gautam intends to sell 17,500 units of promoter shares to the general public/ institutions. Interested individuals are requested to bid for the auction within 15 days from this notice's publication date, i.e., 14th Jestha, 2081. The minimum bid rate for the auction is Rs. 600.
Interested investors should submit their bids at the company's central office located at Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu.
CBBL closed at Rs.853.10. The LTP of CBBLPO is Rs.696.

Headline: Bids Opened for Auction of CBBL Shares; What is the Cut-Off Rate?
Full Content:
The bids received in the auction of 6,06,140 units promoter shares of
Chhimek Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited (CBBL)
have been opened today, i.e. 26th Baisakh, 2079.
The auction had opened on 13th Chaitra, 2078 and concluded on 18th Baisakh, 2079 at the end of banking hours. 6,06,140 units promoter shares were auctioned. BOK Capital Limited was appointed the auction manager. Bids had opened today at the premises of the auction manager, Narayanchaur - Naxal, Kathmandu, starting at 4 pm. The existing promoters, general public, and institutions were all eligible to bid for the auction.
Bank Of Kathmandu Limited is selling its held shares via auction.
According to the auction manager, only one applicant submitted the bid for 2,000 units and
the cut-off rate is Rs. 604.

Headline: Bank of Kathmandu Auctioning Promoter Shares of RMDC and CBBL
Full Content:
Bank of Kathmandu Limited is auctioning the promoter shares of two microfinance companies from today.
Bank of Kathmandu Limited is auctioning the promoter shares of
RMDC Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited
. The auction has opened today, i.e. on 13th Chaitra, and will close on 18th Baisakh, 2079.
1,49,800 units promoter shares of RMDC Laghubitta are being auctioned.
The existing promoters, general public, and institutions are all eligible to bid for the auction. Rs. 540 is the minimum bid rate for the auction. While the minimum bid quantity for promoters’ shares is 2,000 units, there is no upper limit for both shares. Although bidders can bid for the entirety of the issue, they are required to abide by Nepal Rastra Bank's rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity.
BOK Capital Limited is appointed the auction manager.

Headline: Bank of Kathmandu (BOKL) Auctioning Promoter Shares of RMDC Laghubitta and Chhimek Laghubitta from Today
Full Content:
Bank of Kathmandu Limited is auctioning the promoter shares of RMDC Laghubitta and Chhimek Laghubitta. The auction has opened from today, i.e. Magh 27, and will close on 3rd Falgun.
1,50,000 units promoter shares of RMDC Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited and 7,00,000 units of promoter shares of Chhimek Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited are being auctioned. Individual investors, companies, and institutions are all eligible to bid for the auction. While the minimum bid quantity is 100 units for the auction of both the shares, there is no upper limit. However, bidders are required to abide by Nepal Rastra Bank's rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity.
Rs. 520 is the minimum bid rate for the auction of promoter shares of RMDC Laghubitta. Meanwhile, Rs. 600 is the minimum bid rate for the auction of promoter shares of Chhimek Laghubitta. The bid opening date will be declared in the upcoming notice.
